about: Curated list of real Gleam code used to test gleam-in-nim. Edit this file by hand, then run `nim r tools/corpus.nim lock` to refresh corpus/corpus.json. Nothing listed here is vendored: sources are fetched at their pinned commit into .corpus-cache/ (git-ignored).

kinds.snippets: many tiny standalone programs, ideal for the first lexer, parser and type checker tests
kinds.tests: upstream test suites, the closest thing to a specification
kinds.library: a package with few or no dependencies
kinds.core: packages maintained by the Gleam team that almost every project depends on
kinds.framework: larger libraries with rich APIs and heavy use of the type system
kinds.compiler: lexers, parsers, compilers and interpreters written in Gleam, also useful as cross-checks
kinds.reference: not Gleam code, but a machine-readable description of Gleam used as a reference

sources.note: The compiler itself. Its test/ projects and the Gleam code embedded in compiler-core snapshot tests are the primary oracle.
